newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Causeway to raise S$8.64 mln in placement.
newsitem.headline: Causeway to raise S$8.64 mln in placement.

text.p: Trading firm Causeway Investment Ltd said on Tuesday it would privately place 7.445 million new ordinary shares of Singapore $0.60 each at S$1.19 per share.
The company said in a statement the net proceeds from the placement, estimated at S$8.64 million, would be used for development of an existing property, repayment of loans and as working capital.
Phillip Securities Pte Ltd had agreed to subscribe for the shares, representing 10 percent of the existing issued share capital of Causeway.
On Tuesday, Causeway shares ended S$0.03 up at S$1.25.
